candidates.name: Plow Back Rowing Preps
candidates.cardText:
Plow Back Rowing Preps
Novice
1
Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps forward.
2
Begin with arms long, shoulders relaxed and chest open.
3
Pull arms down and back in a plow motion, engaging lats.
4
Return to start with control, maintaining upright posture and tension.

candidates.name: Arms Pulling Straps Airplane Prone On The Box
candidates.cardText:
Arms Pulling Straps Airplane Prone On The Box
Beginner
1
Lie prone on the box, chest just off edge, arms holding straps.
2
Start with arms down, palms facing in, shoulders set away from ears.
3
Lift arms out to a T, squeezing shoulder blades, keeping neck long.
4
Lower with control, maintain neutral spine, repeat for smooth controlled reps.

candidates.name: Arms Pulling Straps Plow Prone On The Box
candidates.cardText:
Arms Pulling Straps Plow Prone On The Box
Beginner
1
Lie prone on the box, chest just off edge, arms holding straps overhead.
2
Start with arms long, palms down, shoulders depressed and neck neutral.
3
Pull arms down toward hips, squeezing lats while keeping torso stable.
4
Return slowly to start, maintaining control and continuous tension on straps.

candidates.name: Backstroke Prep Lying On Box
candidates.cardText:
Backstroke Prep Lying On Box
Beginner
1
Lie prone on the box, chest supported, arms holding straps forward.
2
Start with arms straight, palms facing down, shoulders relaxed.
3
Pull arms back in a sweeping motion, engaging upper back.
4
Return to start with control, keeping neck long and torso stable.

candidates.name: Midback Series 2
candidates.cardText:
Midback Series 2
Novice
1
Sit or lie supported, spine long, arms positioned in a t-pose.
2
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
3
Move arms down to your sides, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
4
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.

candidates.name: Midback Series 3
candidates.cardText:
Midback Series 3
Novice
1
Sit or lie supported, spine long, arms positioned in a v-pose.
2
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
3
Move arms down to your sides, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
4
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.

candidates.name: Midback Series 1
candidates.cardText:
Midback Series 1
Novice
1
Lie supported, spine long, arms straight up toward ceiling.
2
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
3
Move arms down towards your side, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
4
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.

candidates.name: Midback Series Circles Outward
candidates.cardText:
Midback Series Circles Outward
Novice
1
Lay flat on carriage, legs in tabletop position.
2
Start with arms up toward ceiling.
3
Bring arms to your sides, then out to a t-pose, then back to start position.

candidates.name: Midback Series Circles Inward
candidates.cardText:
Midback Series Circles Inward
Novice
1
Lay flat on carriage with arms toward the ceiling.
2
Move arms out to a t-pose.
3
Pull arms to your side, then raise arms back toward ceiling.

candidates.name: Pilates Single Arm Rotations Back Rowing Seated Row
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Single Arm Rotations Back Rowing Seated Row
Beginner
1
Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
2
Pull handle while rotating torso slightly.
3
Keep hips stable and movement controlled.
4
Return arm and torso to start.

candidates.name: Pilates Single Arm Back Rowing Seated Row
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Single Arm Back Rowing Seated Row
Beginner
1
Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
2
Pull handle toward torso, squeezing shoulder blade.
3
Keep torso stable without rotation.
4
Extend arm forward under control.

candidates.name: Pilates Back Rowing Seated Row
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Back Rowing Seated Row
Beginner
1
Sit tall, legs extended, hold straps with arms forward.
2
Pull handles toward torso, squeezing shoulder blades together.
3
Keep chest lifted and spine neutral throughout.
4
Extend arms forward under control.
